audit.why: Even through 1-5, Locke's stages at 6 and first item, skill again at two items matches 52.6% Emerald+ over 2154 games and the on-disk chart. Chart untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes named 'his E cooldown' as your anti-spike without a number, and breakdown.cooldowns claimed Ashen Pursuit 'resets on takedowns'.
audit.why: Ashen Pursuit is a flat 10s at every rank per Riot's data; nothing in Riot's text says it resets on takedowns. Ritual Nails is 10/9/8/7/6s and Purgatory 120/100/80s - those are the real spike and punish clocks.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and breakdown.spikes rebuilt on 10/9/8/7/6s, flat 10s and 120/100/80s; the takedown-reset claim is deleted.

audit.whatIsWrong: Purgatory's grounding never appears anywhere in the full layer, and the page is written as if Locke were the 125-range champion.
audit.why: Purgatory grounds. Akali's only mobility is Shuriken Flip's recast dash and both halves of Perfect Execution, so inside that zone she cannot dash in or out - that is the decisive interaction of the matchup and it was absent. Locke's Ritual Nails is 950 range and Akali is the 125-range melee, so the range framing was inverted.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, phases[0]/[1]/[4].why, breakdown.early, breakdown.wave, breakdown.cooldowns, report[0]/[1]/[5]/[11] now state the grounding and the real 950/125 range gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'the post-E window' was described as ten seconds of nothing without naming the ability or the number.
audit.why: Ashen Pursuit is his only mobility and is a flat 10s, so the punish window is exact and worth stating.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns now name Ashen Pursuit and its flat 10s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said 'Anti-heal is optional - his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal.'
audit.why: Soul Ignition costs him a share of current health per second and heals a portion of it back at the end of the duration. Grievous Wounds applied before it expires cuts exactly that refund, so anti-heal is not optional - the _missing file flags this matchup needs-antiheal on Soul Ignition.
audit.corrected: report[8].t rewritten around cutting the Soul Ignition heal-back.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rune Setup hedged with 'if you're melee'.
audit.why: Akali is the 125-range melee in every instance of this matchup; the conditional is noise.
audit.corrected: report[6].t states the melee page directly.
